title: An RORalpha agonist, ODH-08, inhibits fibrogenic activation of hepatic stellate cells via suppression of SMAD3.
authors: Choi, Haena; Oh, Daehyun; Kim, Hyeon-Ji; Chambugong, Melody; Kim, Mi-Hyun; Lee, Mi-Ock; Park, Hyeung-Geun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究RORalpha激动剂ODH-08抑制肝星状细胞纤维化激活，核心为细胞信号通路与疾病模型，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIMS: Hepatic fibrosis is a dynamic process characterized by the net accumulation of an extracellular matrix resulting from chronic liver injury such as nonalcoholic steatohepatitis. Activation of hepatic stellate cells (HSCs) plays a role in transdifferentiation of quiescent cells into fibrogenic myofibroblasts. We aimed to examine the function of retinoic acid receptor-related orphan receptor alpha (RORalpha) and its novel agonistic ligand, 1-(4-benzyloxybenzyl)-3-(2-dimethylaminoethyl)-thiourea (ODH-08) against activation of HSCs using hepatic fibrosis mouse models. MAIN METHODS: Chemical synthesis, a reporter gene assay, surface plasmon resonance analysis, and a docking study were performed to evaluate ODH-08 as a ligand of RORalpha. In vivo experiments with mice fed a Western diet were performed to evaluate the effect of ODH-08. The human HSC line, Lx-2, and primary mouse HSCs were employed to identify the molecular mechanisms underlying the antifibrogenic effect of ODH-08. KEY FINDINGS: A novel RORalpha-selective ligand, ODH-08, was developed based on modification of JC1-40, an analog of N-methylthiourea. Administration of ODH-08 to the Western diet-fed mice reduced hepatic collagen deposition and expression levels of fibrogenic markers such as alpha-smooth muscle actin and collagen type I alpha 1 chain. Activation of RORalpha-either by transient overexpression of RORalpha or treatment with ODH-08-suppressed the expression of fibrogenic proteins in HSCs. The activation of RORalpha suppressed the activity of SMAD2 and 3, which are the primary downstream proteins of transforming growth factor beta. SIGNIFICANCE: RORalpha and its agonist ODH-08 have a potent antifibrotic effect, which could provide a novel antifibrotic strategy against hepatic fibrosis.
abstract_zh: 目的：肝纤维化是一个动态过程，其特征是由慢性肝损伤（如非酒精性脂肪性肝炎）导致的细胞外基质净积累。肝星状细胞（HSCs）的激活在静止细胞向纤维生成性肌成纤维细胞的转分化中发挥作用。我们旨在利用肝纤维化小鼠模型，研究维甲酸相关孤儿受体α（RORalpha）及其新型激动性配体1-(4-苄氧基苄基)-3-(2-二甲氨基乙基)-硫脲（ODH-08）对HSCs激活的功能。主要方法：采用化学合成、报告基因检测、表面等离子体共振分析和对接研究，评估ODH-08作为RORalpha配体的特性。通过喂食西方饮食的小鼠进行体内实验，评估ODH-08的效果。使用人HSC细胞系Lx-2和原代小鼠HSCs，以确定ODH-08抗纤维化作用的分子机制。主要发现：基于N-甲基硫脲类似物JC1-40的修饰，开发了一种新型RORalpha选择性配体ODH-08。对喂食西方饮食的小鼠给予ODH-08，可减少肝胶原沉积以及纤维化标志物（如α-平滑肌肌动蛋白和I型胶原α1链）的表达水平。通过RORalpha的瞬时过表达或ODH-08处理激活RORalpha，可抑制HSCs中纤维化蛋白的表达。RORalpha的激活抑制了SMAD2和SMAD3的活性，它们是转化生长因子β的主要下游蛋白。意义：RORalpha及其激动剂ODH-08具有强效抗纤维化作用，这可能为肝纤维化提供一种新的抗纤维化策略。
